First, note: August 1624 is a year and month, not a specific day, so the answer will be a year and month.

Add 21 years 8 months to August 1624:

Year: 1624 + 21 = 1645  
Month: August (8th month) + 8 months = 16th month → 16 − 12 = 4th month of the next year.

So year becomes 1645 + 1 = 1646, month = April.

Since no day given, use 1st of month for calculation: 1624-08-01 + 21 years 8 months = 1646-04-01.

FINAL_ANSWER: 1646-04-01
